name: ADS Data Catalogue search (bbox)
publisher: Archaeology Data Service, University of York
response_fields: total.value; hits[].id; hits[].data.title.text; data.description.text; data.resourceType; data.ariadneSubject[].prefLabel; data.spatial[].geopoint {lat,lon} or boundingbox/polygon WKT with centroid; data.landingPage (null for many inventory records); data.accessRights; data.publisher[]; data.originalId; data.otherId
licence: Per record (accessRights). ADS-published records: ADS Terms of Use and Access (research, learning and teaching only; no supply to third parties). PAS: CC-BY. HES and Historic England wrecks: OGL v3. RCAHMW: CC BY NC ND. No API terms published.
attribution: Original depositor, funder if different, and 'Archaeology Data Service (distributor)' with DOI or record link
limits: No published limits; about 350 requests at 1 per second saw no throttling. 50 per page, 10,000-result window.

name: ADS Data Catalogue map mode (markers or geohash grid)
response_fields: Up to 500 trimmed marker hits when the viewport holds 500 or fewer; otherwise zero hits and aggregations.geogridCentroid.grids.buckets[{key: 7-char geohash, doc_count}] plus aggregations.viewport
licence: As search: per record; ADS Terms for ADS-published records
attribution: Original depositor, funder if different, and 'Archaeology Data Service (distributor)' with DOI or record link
limits: None published; 0.5 MB for 450 markers

name: ADS Data Catalogue single record
response_fields: Full record as search hits, plus nearby, similar and parent-collection lists (46 KB sample); /xml for XML
licence: Per record (accessRights)
attribution: Original depositor, funder if different, and 'Archaeology Data Service (distributor)' with DOI or record link
limits: None published

name: Historic England Archive oblique aerial photo index
response_fields: GeoJSON points; properties FRAME_NO, OBLIQUE_FILM_NUMBER, FLIGHT_NUMBER, DATE_FLOWN, Copyright, Filename, YEAR_FLOWN, photographer, pilot
licence: NOT STATED. Public ArcGIS item 3f52b72803504446b3c1add33f67b0b3 with empty licence and credit fields; not on the Open Data Hub.
attribution: Use the per-record Copyright field; typically '© Historic England Archive'
limits: 2,000 per page on the 20260529 service; the older 20250304 views have maxRecordCount 15

name: Historic England Archive vertical aerial photo footprints
response_fields: GeoJSON polygons (frame footprint); properties FRAME_NUMBER, SORTIE_NUMBER, LIBRARY_NUMBER, DATE_FLOWN, DATE_ACCURACY, Copyright, Filename, YEAR_FLOWN
licence: NOT STATED. Public ArcGIS item 7476a999827e469e84373f640243a492 with empty licence field.
attribution: Per-record Copyright field, e.g. 'Source Historic England Archive (USAAF photography)'
limits: 2,000 per page on the 20260529 service; older views 15
